system.story: Corporate-trained, licensed, with access to high-grade pharmaceuticals and cutting-edge protocols.

description.value:
Subclass: Corp-Medtech. Precise, well-supplied, expensive - quality over quantity.

Role Feature - Pharmaceutical Grade

Your compounds are more potent and cleaner - bigger heals, stronger stims with lighter crashes, more reliable toxins. The medic with the best product, when they can afford it.

Signature Tweak

Combat Stims / Administer Dose compounds last longer or carry a reduced downside.

Bonus Skill & Contact

A corporate/pharma-science skill, plus a corp-clinic, pharma-supplier, or medical-datahaus contact.

Corp Records

Licensed medical contractor - in good standing.
